If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over last 5 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.

If sentiment is consistently negative (≤0.33) over last 5 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to offset pessimism.

If sentiment shifts from positive to negative mid-horizon (day 8–15), reduce forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon to reflect sentiment reversal.

If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and forecast shows upward trend, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon (16–30) to prevent overcorrection.

If sentiment is positive but forecast is trending downward, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon to counteract sentiment mismatch.

If sentiment is negative but forecast is trending upward, reduce forecast by 1–2% for late horizon to align with sentiment drift.
